name: dsh-forget-session-en
description: English fork of dsh-forget-session. DeepSeek Harness plugin: adds a "Forget session" item to the session row's "…" menu. After a two-step confirmation it removes the session from the sidebar and from disk (session logs, projection cache, workspace accounting, archived/pinned sets). Since v2.2 it first detaches the live entry from the Session store (official detach channel), which fixes both "the session returns to Ungrouped right after forgetting" and "the files cannot be deleted". Memory data is not affected.
